# X6 R156 — Complete small-B lower-D atlas and paired extra-direction exit

Date: 2026-11-24 (Asia/Shanghai). AUTHOR ANALYTIC PROOF + EXACT FINITE CERTIFICATE PASS; independent review NOT_REVIEWED. Independent portable research, not a formal native Task Result. Continue R155 (28df57db357ec070459788bb880bd10348aa3cc5), R153 and R152; frozen science R121@8085ff663b5987c58a1bc0a4a3b1d7da3a1d89fd and R122@0687aa24f5402da3b35f914dd6907967a9805b94. Preserve P000 V5, ACTIVE Heartbeat World, joint observer; this is the conditional static centered-three-axis BRC gap observer, not native physical time evolution or native residual attribution.

## Statement
For nonzero integer triples v=(x,y,z) let q(v)=max(sum positive coordinates, sum absolute negative coordinates). Enumerate q<=10 with first nonzero coordinate positive, identifying sign only (1935 directions). Use h=(0,x+3y+6z,3x+12y+30z,7x+39y+126z) and the six absolute differences g in order 01,02,03,12,13,23. For w=(136,B,176,D), s=(136+B,312,136+D,B+176,B+D,D+176); F_v=max_j g_j/s_j, eta=min_v F_v, N={v:2F_v<3eta}. All six observations retained.

For every real 0<B<=20 and 0<D<=528,
eta = 3/(136+D) if D<=B;
eta = 3/(136+B) if B<=D<=272+B;
eta = 6/(B+D) if 272+B<=D<=528.
The formulas agree at both seams.

Let U=(4,-4,1), V=(6,-1,0), A=(1,0,0), C=(5,-4,1), K=(5,-1,0), H=(9,-5,1), P=(1,3,-1), R=(7,-1,0), and T=(B+544)/3. Then:

* D<=B: N={U,V}.
* B<=D<=272+B: U,V always; A,C,K,H exactly when D>T. P exactly when B<20 and D>max(T,(1408+22B)/9); R exactly when B<20 and D>max(T,(1496+20B)/9).
* 272+B<=D<=528: A,C,K,H always; U exactly when D<396+5B/4; V exactly when D<408+2B; P and R both exactly when D<min(306+5B/4,312-B).

All strict endpoints excluded as stated; seam membership agrees. In particular for 0<B<20 the extra two directions both enter before the optimizer seam and exit together after the seam, at D=min(306+5B/4,312-B). The exit kink is B=8/3. For B=20 neither ever belongs. Their entry kinks are B=224/19 and B=8 (R155); for B>8, R's entry is strictly later than P's (unless equal with the common T wall). U then V exit separately, since 396+5B/4 < 408+2B. This resolves the extra entrant lifetime over the whole lower-D region, rather than just a local germ. In particular the old R153 ray B=20 is recovered.

## Proof
Three convex polygons, allowing auxiliary boundary B=0 or D=0 only for affine certificates:
I: (0,0),(20,0),(20,20);
II: (0,0),(20,20),(20,292),(0,272);
III: (0,272),(20,292),(20,528),(0,528).
Their candidate optimum functions n/L are (3,136+D), (3,136+B), (6,B+D). For each fixed channel and lambda in {1,3/2}, multiply the comparison by positive L*s_j to obtain the affine expression g_j L-lambda*n*s_j. Nonnegative at the polygon vertices implies nonnegative on the entire polygon. The origin's zero fifth capacity is used only in this multiplied expression, never as a ratio. For each of 1935 directions the certificate finds a fixed channel nonnegative at all vertices for lambda=1, hence F>=n/L. V in I and II, A in III satisfy all six reverse weak inequalities and have equality in channels 03,01,13 respectively at every vertex. Thus they attain n/L throughout.

For lambda=3/2 the certificate finds a fixed nonnegative channel for every outsider to {U,V} in I and to {U,V,A,C,K,H,P,R} in II and III. Strict near membership excludes equality, so this proves full coverage including every polygon boundary. In I every channel of U,V is strictly negative at every vertex, except the fifth zero-gap slack at the auxiliary origin. That slack is strictly negative for B,D>0 because s_13=B+D>0, proving N exactly {U,V}.

Remaining membership is analytic substitution of these gap vectors:
U=(2,6,2,4,0,4); V=(3,6,3,3,0,3); A=(1,3,7,2,6,4); C=(1,3,5,2,6,8); K=(2,3,4,1,6,7); H=(0,3,6,3,6,3); P=(4,9,2,5,6,11); R=(4,9,10,5,6,1).
In II use 2g_j(136+B)<9s_j. U,V satisfy all six; the four common entrants are constrained by channel 13, D>T (all other inequalities hold whenever D>T, by endpoint comparison on 0<=B<=20). P,R additionally require 2*9*(136+B)<9*312, i.e. B<20. P's channel 23 adds D>(1408+22B)/9; R's channel 03 adds D>(1496+20B)/9. All remaining channels are strict on that range (for example the first channel has 2g_01<=8<9, and the fourth has 10(136+B)<9(B+176)). These yield the stated max thresholds. Their extra bounds cross T at 224/19 and 8 respectively; R's bound exceeds P's by (88-2B)/9>0.

In III use g_j(B+D)<9s_j. For U the potentially smallest upper bounds from channels 01,02,12 are 612+7B/2,468-B,396+5B/4; the last is smallest on 0<B<=20. For V they are 408+2B,468-B,528+2B; the first is smallest. A,C,K,H have all channels strictly below threshold in the declared region, by substitution (H's limiting fourth bound D<528+2B is strict for B>0). P,R share the bounds from 01 and 02: D<306+5B/4 and D<312-B. Their fourth bound D<1584/5+4B/5 is larger than their minimum on 0<B<=20 (compare with 312-B). P's sixth gives D<792-11B/2, R's third gives D<1224-10B, both above 528 in this B range. Other channels are automatically strict. Their shared minimum changes branch at B=8/3. This completes all conditions and strict equality cases.

## Evidence
Actual local Python Fraction execution returned CERTIFICATE PASS and FULL DIRECTION CHECK PASS 192. Histograms for first fixed nonnegative channel, optimizer/exclusion:
I [1760,124,50,0,0,1] / [1660,178,93,0,2,0];
II [1809,89,32,1,4,0] / [1709,139,73,1,5,0];
III [1809,89,32,1,4,0] / [1709,139,73,1,5,0].
Each optimizer sum=1935; exclusion sums=1933,1927,1927. Exact full-direction cross-checks at 192 positive rational configurations cover seams, all threshold lines and adjacent intervals on ten B slices. Continuous coverage follows the affine proof, not sample interpolation. Checker: x6_r156_small_B_lower_D_atlas_verify.py. Scientific input/operation: original six signed height differences converted to absolute pair gaps as specified by R121, then exact max-ratio comparisons; no pi, trigonometry, or external physical model. This observer does not infer a native residual or physical update.

## Next
Close 0<B<20, 528<D<1872-B (R148 covers the subsequent high tail). Then attack 20<B and D<528 including the sharp loss of synchronization at 304/3. Preserve original control receipt and existing author records; no claim or formal Result implied.
